integrity: Proof reconstructed from exact ring multiplication; numerical finite-field tests corroborate but are not universal proof. Motivating arXiv preprint inspected; independent external review has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only commutative equicharacteristic split finite local Gorenstein algebras with Hilbert function (1,2,1), nonzero socle product targets, and real product-matrix spectra; no claim for other targets, nonsplit or degenerate rings. Mathematical priority qualified by possible unindexed equivalent bilinear-incidence results.
title: Socle product-matrix spectra detect Witt type in four-dimensional finite local Gorenstein algebras
